subtasks.instructions: Analyze carriers WN and DL for January-February 2025. Use each row's scheduled flight unless duplicate records exist; deduplicate repeated export records by unique flight_id, since flight_id identifies one flight. For each carrier, normalize each route as the two airport codes sorted alphabetically and joined by '-'. (a) Count all scheduled flights by route, including cancelled flights, and select the route with the highest count; state a deterministic tie rule if tied. (b) For each route, completed means cancelled=false; compute departure delay as actual departure minus scheduled departure in local origin time, allowing actual departure after midnight by treating it as the next day when needed. A flight is delayed only when delay >15 minutes. Restrict candidate routes to at least 20 completed flights, then select the route with the highest delayed/completed rate; state counts/rate and tie handling. Return the requested route strings and supporting counts so the manager can verify them.

Analyze carriers AA and UA for January-February 2025. Use each row's scheduled flight unless duplicate records exist; deduplicate repeated export records by unique flight_id, since flight_id identifies one flight. Normalize routes as alphabetically sorted airport-code pairs joined by '-'. For busiest, count all scheduled flights by route including cancelled flights. For worst, exclude cancelled flights, require at least 20 completed flights per route, calculate local departure delay as actual_dep minus sched_dep (handle an actual time after midnight as the next day), classify delayed only if delay exceeds 15 minutes, and maximize delayed/completed. Report any ties and the deterministic tie rule used. Return supporting counts/rates for verification.

Analyze carriers B6 and AS for January-February 2025. Use each row's scheduled flight unless duplicate records exist; deduplicate repeated export records by unique flight_id. Normalize routes as alphabetically sorted airport-code pairs joined by '-'. For B6, parse date and sched_dep/actual_dep as local origin times. For AS, fields are explicitly UTC (date_utc, sched_dep_utc, actual_dep_utc): use airport utc_offset_hours to convert scheduled and actual timestamps to local origin time before calculating departure delay, including date rollover; alternatively note that subtracting corresponding UTC timestamps gives the same duration, but ensure midnight handling is correct. Busiest counts all scheduled flights including cancelled flights. Worst considers only routes with at least 20 completed (cancelled=false) flights; delayed means departure delay >15 minutes; rate is delayed/completed. Report route, supporting counts, rates, and any ties/tie rule.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
for carrier in ['WN','DL']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'airlines/{carrier}.csv').drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy()
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['sched_min']=d.sched_dep.map(lambda x:int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]))
 d['actual_min']=pd.to_numeric(d.actual_dep.str[:2],errors='coerce')*60+pd.to_numeric(d.actual_dep.str[3:],errors='coerce')
 d['delay']=d.actual_min-d.sched_min
 d.loc[d.delay<0,'delay']+=1440
 # busiest tie lex route
 counts=d.groupby('route').size().sort_index(); mx=counts.max(); busy=counts[counts==mx].index[0]
 c=d[d.cancelled.eq(False)].copy(); stats=c.groupby('route').agg(completed=('flight_id','size'),delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 stats['rate']=stats.delayed/stats.completed
 cand=stats[stats.completed>=20]; best_rate=cand.rate.max(); best=cand[cand.rate==best_rate].sort_index().iloc[0]
 print('\n',carrier,'duplicates',len(d), 'busy',busy,mx,'ties',counts[counts==mx].to_dict())
 print('worst',cand[cand.rate==best_rate].to_string(), 'all candidates',cand.sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(10).to_string())
 print('cancel values',d.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())

import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
for carrier,file in [('B6','airlines/B6.csv'),('AS','airlines/AS.csv')]:
 d=pd.read_csv(file)
 print('\n',carrier,'duplicates',d.flight_id.duplicated().sum(), 'cancel',d.cancelled.value_counts().to_dict())
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy()
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 if carrier=='B6':
  d['sched_ts']=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep)
  d['actual_ts']=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep)
 else:
  # UTC timestamps; local conversion not needed duration, but make explicit
  d['sched_ts']=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc,utc=True)
  d['actual_ts']=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc,utc=True)
 d['delay_min']=(d.actual_ts-d.sched_ts).dt.total_seconds()/60
 busy=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 print('busy',busy.head(10).to_dict())
 c=d[~d.cancelled]
 g=c.groupby('route').agg(completed=('flight_id','size'),delayed=('delay_min',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 g['rate_percent']=100*g.delayed/g.completed
 print(g[g.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate_percent','route'],ascending=[False,True]).to_string())
 print('all routes rows',d.route.value_counts().to_dict())
